items._cn_summary: Roy Montgomery与Martha Skye Murphy合作的《Nebular》是一张五人短篇dreampop合集，两人通过共同使用Tascam多轨录音机的方式找到创作默契，将Montgomery标志性的氛围吉他与Murphy被重新塑形为无歌词人声质感的歌剧式唱腔相融合。专辑中段17分钟的《The Play of Light and Dark》以Montgomery的节奏感钟鸣氛围为底，Murphy在其中自由人声化，构建出一种粘稠的吟唱质感；终曲《At Dusk》由Mary Lattimore的竖琴出现收束。制作上故意保留粗糙与年代感，混音方式让它听起来像一张未发行的4AD遗作。这张专辑呈现出艺术家个人特征融合后的新声响，介于独立吉他氛围与人声实验之间。

items.excerpt: jason calhoun’s fifth release for Dear Life Records, "On revelations of divine love Calhoun has assembled an especially potent album of work that whirrs, hums, and glows. Unlike his recent output centered around extended, hypnotic compositions, the fourteen tracks here immediately request your attention and... more
items.body:
jason calhoun’s fifth release for Dear Life Records,

"On revelations of divine love Calhoun has assembled an especially potent album of work that whirrs, hums, and glows. Unlike his recent output centered around extended, hypnotic compositions, the fourteen tracks here immediately request your attention and curiosity. Their concision only underscores one of his greatest strengths: the ability to capture an evaporating, fleeting moment, and hold it close.

The title is a nod to British Anchoress Julian of Norwich, whose collected writing of the same title is the earliest of any woman written in English. Here it serves as a unifying theme for Calhoun's particular palette of restless textures and tentative melodies. This is personal music, to be sure, but it also feels tactile, almost taffy-like in its presentation—and with such a potent combination, it is hard to resist a smile while listening. Like when the insistent pulse grounding 'last one' suddenly changes color as yawning tones reveal themselves, or how 'eye dilation' tiptoes into the room with each note sounding like a carefully chosen step. Though never precious or fussy, the album remains resolutely intimate.

Calhoun puts it plainly: “Julian of Norwich says “‘All shall be well, and all shall be well, and all manner of thing shall be well’. These days, I’ve been having my doubts that this is true. As no solution to the issue at hand, I look for the revelations of divine love in my life, and I find them--in my partner asleep on the floor in our studio, my survival of a social interaction with a stranger, being bad at chess. Don't ask me what they mean-I'm still figuring that out myself. Maybe we can figure it out together.” It is from this place of doubt, searching, and openness that the album finds its footing."
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑收录十四首短小精悍的作品，以电子声响为核心，营造出嗡鸣、闪烁的绵密氛围。与此前以长篇催眠式构作为主的创作路线不同，此次聚焦于捕捉稍纵即逝的瞬间，将不安分的织体与试探性的旋律压缩在紧凑的篇幅内。整体质地柔韧如太妃糖，触感实在而亲密，既内省又带有温度。标题致敬英国修女朱利安关于神爱之启示的写作，将其私人化的灵性探寻串联为统一主题。创作者公开坦露怀疑与困惑，从日常生活中寻找微小的神性显现——爱人沉睡的姿态、一次社交互动的完成、甚至下棋的笨拙——以此作为创作立足点。专辑在亲密感与开放性之间取得平衡，既有冥想式的沉浸感，又不失对当下感受的敏锐回应。

items.excerpt: First re-pressing in years of Mark Ernestus & Moritz Von Oswald’s divine, final Rhythm & Sound release, heeling to tradition with a one-riddim album focussed on its carousel of roots reggae legends; Sugar Minott, Paul St. Hilaire, Willi Williams, Jah Cotton, Bobbo Shanti, and more In 2005 Rhythm & Sound capped their holy... more
items.body:
First re-pressing in years of Mark Ernestus & Moritz Von Oswald’s divine, final Rhythm & Sound release, heeling to tradition with a one-riddim album focussed on its carousel of roots reggae legends; Sugar Minott, Paul St. Hilaire, Willi Williams, Jah Cotton, Bobbo Shanti, and more

In 2005 Rhythm & Sound capped their holy mountain catalogue with ‘See Mi Yah’, a 7 x 7” set and LP which completed a 10 year run of inspired dub productions with their purest offering to the form. At the time, younger ears to their music would be left perplexed by the lack of instrumental variation - but any others with a little knowledge of one-riddim set traditions knew it was their ultimate ode to roots reggae fundamentals, after respectfully messing with the style & pattern across the Burial Mix 10”s (as collected in ‘w/ The Artists’), and the more radical 12” mutations of the Rhythm & Sound series, proper, since 1996 (not to mention birthing dub house-techno before that).     

Seeing off the project in fine style, Ernestus & Von Oswald gave studio time to their favourite vocalists, generating a slew of original performances displaying the range and depth of roots reggae’s elders and contemporary torch carriers on their signature backdrop of air-trodding bass and powdered dub chords. We were blessed to distribute it in the UK at the time, so many of these cuts are hard etched to the memory, from the ghostly croon of Willi Williams’ title piece thru the gruff gravitas of Bobbo Shanti, the duet between Ras Donovan & Ras Perez, and of course Sugar Minott’s mellifluous reggae soul.

In the year following ‘See Mi Yah’, Rhythm & Sound were naturally elected to edit and master a re-up of The Congos & Friends’ one-riddim album ’Fisherman Style’ for our then warehouse neighbours Blood & Fire Records, sealing their era of roots reflection by appropriately saluting the originators, in parallel to their Wackies reissue scheme, and before Ernestus (and Mark Ainley) would go on to found the more digi-devoted reissue label, Dug Out. Some 20 years of satisfaction later, time has proven this album holds its meditative weight.
items._genre: dub / roots reggae / electronic / dub techno
items._cn_summary: Rhythm & Sound 由 Mark Ernestus 与 Moritz Von Oswald 组成的二人组合，以一系列深度抽象的 dub 制作闻名。《See Mi Yah》作为其2005年收官之作，回归最纯粹的雷鬼根基，采用一 riddim 通篇贯穿的7首单曲套装形式，邀请 Sugar Minott、Paul St. Hilaire、Willi Williams 等根源雷鬼歌手在极简的低频与回响和弦上即兴演唱。专辑剥离了早前 12 寸单曲系列中更具实验性的 dub house 与 techno 变异，呈现出近乎冥想的内向质感，将人声置于 dub 空间的最前端。评论将其置于该项目十年创作脉络的终点，强调其对根源传统的致敬，以及在电子制作手法与雷鬼精神之间长期探索后所达到的凝练状态。

items.excerpt: Produced by Neek and Jabu's Amos Childs (aka O$VMV$M), Manonmars' third album is syrupy suite of smoke-hazed recollections and free associated reflections set to decelerated bumps, sluggish samples and cloudy drones = sturdy biz FFO Young Echo, Massive Attack, Cold Light, Ka, MIKE, King Vision Ultra, Coby... more
items.body:
Produced by Neek and Jabu's Amos Childs (aka O$VMV$M), Manonmars' third album is syrupy suite of smoke-hazed recollections and free associated reflections set to decelerated bumps, sluggish samples and cloudy drones = sturdy biz FFO Young Echo, Massive Attack, Cold Light, Ka, MIKE, King Vision Ultra, Coby Sey.

Manonmars' 2018 debut is one of those albums we still go back to periodically. It's that rare meeting of minds: a space for O$VMV$M to flex their production muscle and a scratchpad for London-based MC, painter and photographer Jack Martyn Richardson to sketch out a distinct vision of England. And His experiences and impressions on 'Entertainment System' still feel chewable. "Goddess on my arm and both our phones got no service," he quips on 'Goddess'. "Acid is lysergic, psychedelic rock is Turkish." His rhymes aren't throwaway, they map out an underground that's very recognisable, shadowed by O$VMV$M's tuff, effective soundscapes - beats that reference trip-hop, ambient music, exotica and '70s movie soundtracks as much as they do US rap. 

On opener 'Flam3throw3r', Mars raps in double-time over shrill horns that blot out any trace of a beat; Neek and Childs sound as if they relish the negative space, adding chic sword swipes to a track that's got little else to do with the Wu Tang Clan. When a lumbering beat kicks in on 'Decathlon', flipping from downtempo to no-tempo in the final act, it sounds as if it's just there to assert O$VMV$M's commitment to slowness - Mars doesn't even seem to notice, rhyming casually but never losing his flow.

Bristol mainstays Franco Franco and Dali de Saint Paul turn up to assist on 'Volcanic Shield', one of the album's most conventional bangers, led by O$VMV$M's skittering Surf Gang-like beats and morse code blips, and cold light's Birthmark lends his voice to 'Infinite', going bar for bar with Mars over Neek and Childs' slackened funk, blaring out like an old tape on a busted in-car audio system. 'Firewater' takes the same approach, leaving Mars to do his best as snares splash across the spectrum with added sax from Brum-based sound artist Lorenzo Prati. "My bitch white, she can scuba dive and ice climb," he spits. "Put the drink down, I wasn't in my right mind." 

It's music that laughs through the tears - what could be more British than that?

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是英国制作组合与伦敦MC的第三次合作，延续了烟雾弥漫、低速节拍的声场美学。制作上融合trip-hop、ambient、exotica及七十年代电影配乐元素，节奏刻意放慢甚至消解，留出大量负空间供萨克斯、摩尔斯电码音效和失真采样填充。MC的歌词以双倍速韵脚勾勒出英国地下文化的具象场景，文本密度高且具画面感，引用涉及迷幻药历史与日常观察。客串阵容包括Bristol与Birmingham的地下艺人，增添了地域性的声音层次。整体呈现出一种'笑着流泪'的英式气质，在抽象嘻哈与前卫电子之间寻找平衡点。

items._cn_summary: 比利时自由金属集体 Neptunian Maximalism 带来现场专辑《Snakes on an Astral Plane: Nāgabhūtaṃ》，于 2025 年 4 月录制完成。乐评人指出，即兴音乐之所以达到最佳状态，在于演奏者在演奏时将自我意识抛诸门外。文章从 Sun Ra 电影《Space Is the Place》切入，探讨音乐作为对抗集体麻木的解药、引领人们探索未知世界的力量，并强调实验性的本质在于拒绝被定义与划界。专辑延续了乐队以即兴为核心、融合金属体量与迷幻氛围的创作路径，将萨满意象与太空迷思并置，在沉重 riff 与自由延展的空间之间游走。短摘未能完整呈现音乐细节，但揭示了创作背后的哲学动机与集体即兴的精神追求。

items.body: “Incarnate” marks the third album from the American band False Figure, with the trio delivering eleven tracks on this release. The band’s influences clearly hark back to the golden era of the 80s, spanning various—although closely related—genres. Dark-Wave elements are immediately recognizable, primarily brought to life through the guitar work, alongside subtle traces of Shoegaze. At times, the sound leans more towards Rock, while there are even passages reminiscent of Jangle-Pop—think Aztec Camera. It feels like an imaginary meeting point between The Cure, Joy Division, The Smiths, The Jesus & Mary Chain, and Aztec Camera. “Incarnate” is a diverse record, featuring several standout tracks. This variety makes for an accessible listening experience, ensuring that there is something to appeal to a wide range of listeners. Despite its stylistic diversity, the album never feels disjointed; rather, it comes across as a tight and cohesive production. False Figure was not a band I was particularly familiar with, but this release has certainly won me over. (Rating:7½). Side-Line reported on the False Figure release “Incarnate” on Cruel Subordination Records in March 2026, detailing the tracklist and the limited vinyl pressing. Watch the clip “Say Nothing”: About False Figure False Figure started as a Bay Area three-piece built around Andrés Ruiz (guitar, vocals), with Ian on drums and Alex on bass. In 2017, the band self-released the 7″ single “Cardinal Cross b/w Exhale”. A self-titled album followed on May 25, 2018, released by Near Dark Records and Last Hour Records. On June 11, 2019, the band released the EP “A Promised End.” Later cassette pressings followed via Reclusion Records and Transylvanian Recordings. On November 1, 2022, the band released “Castigations.” Three years later, in late 2025 and early 2026, the band issued advance tracks for “Incarnate,” including “Flowers in Bloom,” released on January 29, 2026. For “Incarnate” the line-up consisted of Kevin Defranco (guitars), Kienan Hamilton (bass guitar), and Andrés Ruiz (vocals, guitars, drum programming, keys). The album, released via Cruel Subordination Records on digital, vinyl, and cassette formats, is the band’s third full-length.
items._cn_summary: False Figure的第三张专辑《Incarnate》收录十一首作品，以吉他驱动的暗潮基调为骨架，融合了Shoegaze的朦胧质感与Jangle-Pop的明亮和弦进行。评论将其定位在The Cure、Joy Division、The Smiths等八十年代经典乐队的交汇点上，风格虽多元但整体保持了紧凑与连贯。专辑并未走向极端实验，而是在传统后朋克语汇内做编排变化，因此既具备一定的可听性，也因类型元素较为熟悉而缺少强烈的新意。制作上以独立厂牌Cruel Subordination Records发行黑胶与磁带，延续了地下暗潮场景的发行逻辑。对于熟悉暗潮与后朋克传统的听众，这是一张结构完整、情绪层次分明的作品，但其在音色设计与节奏编排上并未突破类型边界。

items.body: 2026.08.06 西ノルウェーのフィヨルドの奥地、フォルデで開催 ノルウェーの小さな町で毎年、開催されるワールドミュージックの祭典「フォルデ・フェスティバル」。今年で36回目を迎え、ヨーロッパの優れた音楽祭に贈られる「ヨーロッパ芸術祭賞」TOP 5にも選出されている名門フェスについて、現地レポートが届きました！ 野崎洋子 音楽プロデューサー 1966年千葉県生まれ。日本大学文理学部出身。 メーカー勤務を経て96年よりケルト圏や北欧の伝統音楽を紹介する個人事務所THE MUSIC PLANTを設立。 コンサ... 詳しく見る 東京ではまだ梅雨が続く6月末。ヨーロッパでの別の仕事を終え、筆者はフィヨルドが美しいノルウェー西部にあるフォルデという町にやってきた。人口は1万人ほどのこの町で行われるフォルデ・フェスティバル（Førdefestivalen）は、スカンジナビア半島最大のフォーク／ワールドミュージックの祭典。1990年にスタートし、毎年20〜25か国から約250人の奏者が集まり、2万人規模の来場者を楽しませる。 今年の出演アーティストの音源がまとめられている公式プレイリスト なぜ、小さな町でフェスを開催できるのか 普段は静かなこの町も、音楽祭の期間中は、コンサートホールやスタジアムはもちろん、ホテルの宴会場、公園、アートギャラリー、ショッピングセンターなどにもステージが組まれ、有料のコンサート以外にも無料ライヴや子どもイベント、無料朝食会、セミナーなど豊富なプログラムが組まれる。 気軽に参加できる無料朝食会。体育館のような広い場所で行なわれ、近所の人や地元の友人と再会しコンサートへ一緒に行く機会につながる photo: Anders Lillebo なぜ、この小さな町でこんなことが可能なのか。北海油田で潤うノルウェーという国が文化支援に力を入れているということが、まず大きな一因だし使いやすい助成金のシステムも心強いが、加えてイベントがもつ「広い視野」「音楽愛」も重要要素だ。 今回も、私をはじめ多くの音楽ジャーナリスト、外国のフェスの音楽監督、エージェント、マネージメントが世界中から20人ほど集められ、交流の場が設けられた。音楽産業にとっては厳しい時代だが、こうした志を同じくする者たちが集まり情報交換、そして音楽愛を分かち合う。ノルウェーがその「ハブ」になることに、彼らは大きな誇りを感じているのだ。 この地に音楽関係者が集められたところで、大きな利益を生むビジネスが明日生まれてくることはない。しかし実際、私もここ12年の間に、この音楽祭で出会ったヤヌシュ・プルシノフスキ（ポーランド）や、ライコー・フェーリックス（セルビア）を日本に招聘することができた。文化イベントに国のトップがやって来て「この産業は自国にいくらの利益をもたらす」と言ってしまうような国とはレベルが違うのだ。 20〜25か国から約250名のアーティストが出演！ 今回の多彩な顔ぶれ 世界を舞台に活躍するコラ（西アフリカの民族楽器）奏者のセク・ケイタ（セネガル）にとって、アフリカ外における最初のコンサートは、この音楽祭だったという。今年は、その公演からちょうど30周年ということで、プログラム監督を長年勤めたヒルダ・ビョルクンと一緒に誇らしげに記念写真に収まるセクの姿がまぶしかった。 セク・ケイタ photo: Arve Ullebø 野外の公園で子ども向けの楽しいモーニング・コンサートを行なった、ボスニア出身のアルミル・メシュコヴィッチ Almir Meskovic（フィドル）とセルビア出身のダニエル・ラザル Daniel Lazar（アコーディオン）は、留学先であるノルウェーの音楽アカデミーで出会い、ここでデュオを結成し、ここをベースに精力的に活動を続けている。そんな話を聞くと、音楽に不可能なことはないのかもしれないと信じたくなる。 今年も、例年にもれずヨーロッパ、アジア、中東、アフリカなどからたくさんのアーティストが集まったが、個人的にもっとも気になったのは、北欧の“楽器に愛された男たち”、リュドヴァル・ミェルヴァ・カー Rydvall Mjelva Carrの3人だ。3つの弦楽器が、ひとつの塊となってうねるようなサウンドを作り出す様は、まるでトリオ時代のヴェーセンを思わせる。 左からエリック・リュドヴァル（ニッケルハルパ）、オーラヴ・ミェルヴァ（ハーディングフェーレ）、アレ・カー（ブズーキ） photo: Lieve Boussauw ブズーキのアレ・カーは、別バンドのドリーマーズ・サーカスのメンバーとして9月に来日が決定。こちらはクラシックのヴァイオリン奏者で昨年レオニー・ソニング音楽賞を受賞したルネ・トンスゴー・ソレンセン（Danish String Quartet）が参加している注目のグループだ。 2026年の来日公演が話題となったドンバスの娘たち Daughters of Donbas（ウクライナ／カナダ）も元気な姿を見せてくれた。彼女たちをはじめ、キナリス Kinnaris Q（スコットランド）や、カアマニョ ＆ アメイシェイラス Caamaño & Ameixeiras（スペイン北西部の自治州ガリシア）、ラ・ペルラ La Perla（コロンビア）など、今年のフォルデは女性バンドの活躍ぶりが目立つ。 ほかにも、姉弟デュオのパルヴィーン ＆ イリヤス・カーン Parveen & Ilyas Khan（インド）による古典からヒューマンビートボックスまで盛り込んだステージや、自らを「古代都市アレッポの最後の吐息」と銘打ちダーヴィシュのダンサーを従えて登場したジャワ Jawa（シリア）のステージも素晴らしかった。 パルヴィーン＆イリヤス・カーン photo: Anders Lillebo 音楽マニアではない、地元の人たちが集うフェス 5日間で、20弱のアーティストのライヴを体験することができたが、ここに紹介したのは、そのほんの一部。 実際、地元の人々とこれほど広範囲における世界の音楽を聴いていると、客層がいわゆる音楽マニアではないのも、この音楽祭の強みではないかと感じられた。普段の彼らはラジオやテレビから流れる音楽をただ耳にしているだけかもしれない。そんな人たちもこの期間だけは新しい音楽に心を開き、楽しむ。 この町の多くの人々が子どもの頃からこのフェスを経験し、時にはボランティアに参加したりして、すべてが深く人々の間に根付いているのだ。こういった町がもつ知的財産はお金を出しても買えないし、短期間で築くこともできない。だがそれはとても力強く、同時に簡単に奪われるものでもない。 フォルデ・フェスでは毎年テーマが決められている。今年のテーマは「平和！（ノルウェー語でFred!）」。音楽の社会における役割を改めて確信した5日間だった。 「フォルデ・フェス」公式サイト ワークライフバランスの良いノルウェーのオーケストラ〜子どもの入学式は有給!? 同僚とベリー狩りやスキーも アンスネスが立ち上げたノルウェー「ローセンダール室内楽フェスティヴァル」が閉幕

items._cn_summary: 本文为挪威西部小镇Førde举办的第36届世界音乐节Førdefestivalen的现场报道。该音乐节自1990年起每年邀请20至25个国家约250位音乐家，在人口仅1万的城镇吸引两万名观众，是斯堪的纳维亚最大的民间与世界音乐盛会。文章重点介绍了塞内加尔科拉琴演奏家Seckou Keita、波斯尼亚与塞尔维亚音乐家组成的二重奏、北欧弦乐三人组Rydvall Mjelva Carr（融合尼克尔哈尔帕、哈丁费勒琴、布祖基琴），以及来自乌克兰、哥伦比亚、印度、叙利亚等地的多支乐队，其中女性音乐人表现尤为突出。作者强调音乐节根植于当地社区文化，挪威的公共文化资助体系与民众从童年起便参与其中的传统是其得以持续运转的核心。本届主题为'和平'，彰显音乐在社会中的联结作用。

items.body:
According to its founder, Eugene Rodriguez, who also sings and plays on the record, Los Cenzontles is a �musical group and non-profit organization, which I founded over thirty years ago.�  As he continues in the album�s liner notes, the group �has a long history of producing projects exploring Mexico�s deep roots and our connections with various traditions that, so far, have included Irish, Louisiana Creole, Cuban, American cowboy, classical, pop, rock, and blues�, the latest of which is
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
. Los Cenzontles translates to the mockingbird, or, from its Aztec root word, the bird of four hundred voices. This is a fitting name for the range of musical diversity represented here.
With songs sung in Spanish, Hawaiian, and English, the concept traces back to the legacy of Mexican cowboys who travelled from California to the Hawaiian Islands to wrangle the long-horned cattle introduced there in the nineteenth century. They also brought the guitar. The 16 tracks feature old Hawaiian songs with new Spanish lyrics, old Mexican songs with new Hawaiian lyrics, new compositions, and traditional Americana. Yet it is an entirely cohesive musical package held together by dense arrangements of ukuleles, guitars, Mexican harp, and accordion.
Sonny Lim & David Hidalgo
Besides their distinctive voices, the headline artists Taj Mahal and David Hidalgo provide the gravitas and musicianship that their long and distinguished careers have earned. According to the liner notes, they were the catalysts behind the project and facilitated the choice of songs, arrangements, and played a range of instruments. On vocals they are joined by Hawaiian natives Gary Haleamau, Sheldeen Haleamau, Sonny Lim, and long-time Cenzontles member Fabiola Trujillo.
Deportee
To give a taste of the sessions, included before the traditional �Fishin� Blues� is Taj Mahal teaching the musicians how to play it. Sung by David Hildalgo,  the lovely �A Matter of Time� comes from the 1984 album
Will the Wolf Survive
by his most famous project, Los Lobos. Another standout for me, �Navegar� features a slack string guitar solo reminiscent of Duane Eddie and one of many tasty lap steel turns by Sonny Lim. Their interpretation of Woody Guthrie's �Deportee� moves into social commentary, highlighting the cruel realities of being a migrant worker in America.
Vaquero Paniolo
Recorded over five days, mostly live in one room at the Los Cenzontles headquarters in San Pablo, California, including the talents of some of their academy�s students, the recording has real spontaneity to it. Arrangements are stretched by improvisations, sometimes by several different instruments on a single tune. The project also represents a great spirit of cooperation and diversity of language, culture, age, and gender. It includes the inputs of musical legends, seasoned pros, and amateurs. The wonderfully rich and often stereotyped musical cultures of both Mexico and Hawaii are represented here with the authenticity of lived experience.
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
is a worthy addition to Los Cenzontles� important work. Quoting Rodriguez again, �Culture is a fabric within which we are all woven.�

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑探索了一个鲜为人知的历史脉络：十九世纪墨西哥牧人从加州前往夏威夷管理长角牛，将吉他带到群岛。十六首曲目涵盖西班牙语、夏威夷语和英语演唱，旧曲新词交织，传统美洲民谣与全新创作并存。演出阵容横跨老牌传奇与年轻学员，在加州圣巴勃罗的总部一室之内以密集的尤克里里、墨西哥竖琴与手风琴编织出统一的声响。塔吉·马哈尔和大卫·伊达尔戈作为项目催化剂参与创作与编曲，并贡献了各自标志性的嗓音与乐器演奏。录音强调现场感与即兴延展，单曲中常有多件乐器轮流即兴。木匠与夏威夷两地丰厚却常被刻板化的音乐传统在此交汇，呈现多元语言、文化、年龄与性别合作的理念。

items.body: For an overview of the what, the why, and the where of this music, do read my review of Volume 1 of this series. Essentially, this collection is more of what made Volume 1 so infectious. Yet, what makes this music so fascinating in general, that is, beyond its unswerving ability to fill dance floors, is the fact that these two islands, part of the Paises Africanos de Lingua Oficial Portuguesa (PALOP) regions of the world, are the second smallest African country; Seychelles is smaller. There are only 12 villages on Sao Tom�, lots of rain forest and, not surprisingly, lots of rain. I mention this because one could be fooled into thinking, with music like what�s on offer here, there must have been a music scene larger than there actually was. Not that little was happening, but that less got recorded or released than it might have had there been a city such as Lagos or Nairobi with the studios, labels, and pressing plants to better document it all. The music here, like Volume 1- recorded during Africa�s so-called golden age- is known as Puxa, a complex stew of ingredients from other former African Portuguese colonies mixed with rhythms that, with the help of dancers, can summon spirits or exorcise demons. At least according to some. It�s worth knowing that a 100 years or so ago, the Portuguese banned Puxa dance; it�s also worth knowing they appear to have failed miserably at this silly endeavor. Tucked away in modern Puxa is merengue, Kompas, Soukouss, Benga, and much else. One suspects much of this is coincidental, while other grooves were definitely imported considering both Portuguese rule and the islands� location over the Atlantic from the Caribbean. But don�t be fooled into thinking these two islands don�t have their own thing, as the sounds on this collection show. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s - Pedro Lima Pedro Lima, who has featured in his own Bongo Joe collection, leads a fiery band, complete with choked guitar vamps tussling with a kit drummer as a lead guitar comments from the sidelines on �Sossegado.� Elsewhere, Sangazuza demonstrates what happens when the bass and keys drop out, leaving the drummers and guitars to ride out a groove and drive dancers mad in the process. Check �Sono s� ku� de t�ma� or �Mairo bi cedo� for their ability to place a firm finger on the pulse. Over 15 tracks, the collection shows off multiple guitars weaving and circling one another, with lead and harmony vocals constantly in response, becoming part of the songs� melodic framework. At any given moment, vocals give way as the music unspools and floats on grooves that must have gone on for hours live. Africa Negra�s �Apoi�mos a luta dos nossos irm�os� is one example. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s by Various Artists In general, what�s on offer here, like Volume 1, was recorded at Radio Sao Tom� e Principe (RSTP), often taped in the courtyard outside at night, and released on cassette or occasionally, vinyl. It captures the joy of post-1975 independence and only fizzled out as styles changed and musicians struggled to make ends meet. Yet, take a quick listen to recent RSTP programming, which features musicians such as Babilonia or Calema, and you�ll still hear Puxa rhythms, showing just how potent the music form this two-island nation is on a global level. And Bongo Joe, who have also released two volumes featuring the above mentioned Africa Negra, have given this music the treatment it deserves, with extensive notes on the country�s history, vintage photographs, and band discographies. Various Artists - L�ve L�ve (Volume1) (Review) Pedro Lima - Maguidala (Review) Ann O'aro - Bleu (Review)

items._cn_summary: 这张合辑聚焦圣多美和普林西比这两个非洲小岛在七八十年代录制的Puxa舞厅音乐，将葡萄牙前殖民地与加勒比海地区的节奏传统熔于一炉。评论指出，Puxa是多种非洲葡语区风格的混合体，包含merengue、Kompas、Soukouss、Benga等元素，融合吉他即兴、层次化人声对位与放克律动，形成绵长而催眠的现场延伸感。Pedro Lima领衔的乐队以紧凑的吉他riff与鼓组对位为核心，Sangazuza则展示去掉贝斯与键盘后纯鼓与吉他驱动的狂热舞曲质地。专辑收录15首曲目，呈现多重吉他编织与人声交替的旋律框架。作为Bongo Joe发行的独立小厂牌再版项目，为小众岛屿音乐场景提供了一份罕见的档案性记录，兼顾舞池实用性与文化研究价值。

items.body: Those of us who have been digging into Analog Africa�s increasingly formidable releases over the last two decades are well aware of the massive amount of raw, vodun-based Sato and Sakpata-derived funk the label has issued by Benin�s most prolific 1970s-era band, the Orchestre Poly-Ritmo. AA has dropped no fewer than 3 compilations of their heaviest material, as well as a reissue of the band�s first LP, in an effort to give them the international status they deserve. That being said, what might be different about this collection of their music? And who is Antoine Dougb�? Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa As it turns out, Dougb� was a song-conjurer whose mode of musical transfer was slapping his legs in a rhythm known as Cavacha, a groove created by drummer Belobi Meridjo, who was inspired by a train cadence that he worked into a pattern that ultimately spread like a 21st century California wildfire throughout Congolese pop music in the mid-1970s. Dougb�, known as the �Devil�s Prime Minister,� was also a practitioner of vodun who inspired fear in any musician he felt was unsuited to play his music, which is how he landed on working exclusively Poly-Ritmo, as he felt they could nail what he wanted in ways other bands couldn�t. His recording career was brief - 3 albums and a few singles - but as this collection shows, it was potent. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa Because of the era from which this music dates, it�s not surprising that the recording and instrument tones have changed - the guitars have a plastic sheen and synthesizers appear- even if the music remains rooted in the 1970s. Perhaps the influence of the Cuban son is more apparent here than on other Poly-Ritmo collections, especially in the collection�s initial offerings. And yes, Congolese rumba, then shaking all of sub-Saharan Africa to its knees, is present too. �Ma Won Min Towe Leo� is one example. Opening with a bed of synthesizers, the shimmering guitars, tinny, seemingly squeezed dry by the 80s themselves, lock in over relentless high-hat-focused grooves. The guitars finally start firing in different directions midway through, before that synth weaves back in, forming a bed underneath it all. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa �We Tayi Sin Assi Tche� is much more overtly Cuban. With its insistent cowbell, classic, nasal vocal call and response, and tight, repeated guitar figures, its debt to mid-twentieth century Afro-Cuban sons is transparent. Another track, �Djomido Ma Dougbe Tche� rides a groove reminiscent of 70�s-era Franco classic �Liberte.� The pulse is relentless, and the guitar solo repeats a tight repetition of a few notes, driving listeners to ecstasy all the while. However, none of this music is a mere copy of its influences; rather, like so much potent pop coming from the continent at the time, it is a swirl of major influences rendered by local rhythms and vocal phrasing to give it specific identity, in this case, to Benin. Dougb�s musical role on this collection is a bit murky. One of his three albums has a photo of him, fully mic�d behind a collection of hand drums, so perhaps he served as a percussionist/vocalist; this release never explains. He wasn�t a songwriter in the traditional sense. It seems he was more of an instigator and arranger, but his thumbprint was apparently heavy enough to warrant his name on the records he was involved with. Whatever the case, in his brief run as a recording artist, he and Poly-Ritmo produced a handful of driving, Cavacha-inspired grooves that can still wear holes in club floors. Further reading: Petrona Mart�nez - Ancestras (Review) Gnonnas Pedro & His Dadjes - Roi De L'Agbadja Moderne 1974-1983 (Review)

items._cn_summary: Analog Africa厂牌整理了贝宁传奇乐队Orchestre Poly-Rythmo与创作核心Antoine Dougbé在1977至1982年间的合作录音。Dougbé以独特的拍腿Cavacha节奏著称，其根源在于鼓手Belobi Meridjo从火车节奏中提炼的律动，这一模式在七十年代中期席卷刚果流行音乐。Dougbé本人作为伏都教信仰者，对音乐演奏者有严苛要求，最终只与Poly-Rythmo长期合作。其短暂录音生涯留下三张专辑与若干单曲，合辑精选呈现了乐队在古巴son与刚果伦巴影响下的演变轨迹。曲目制作上，吉他带有塑料质感光泽，合成器开始进入编曲，呈现七十年代末至八十年代初的过渡音色特征。整张合辑凸显贝宁本土传统节奏、古巴son的明亮律动与刚果伦巴的摇摆感之间的交汇，是研究西非流行音乐流变的重要文献。

items.artist: Dominique Cravic et les Primitifs du futur
items.excerpt:

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.
Tiny Sun -
Vanishment
(Review)
Carolina Chocolate Drops -
Genuine Negro Jig
(Review)
items.label: Buda Musique
items._genre: musette / French chanson / folk revival / eclectic fusion / vintage jazz
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是Dominique Cravic与Les Primitifs du futur的第五张录音，由地下漫画家Robert Crumb担任封面绘制。整体风格难以归类，从巴尔斯-缪塞特传统延伸至拉格泰里、壶乐队、法国香颂、斯基夫尔等多种流派的杂糅。27首短曲以Cravic带叙述感的法语演唱为核心，伴奏乐器丰富多样，包括手风琴、萨克斯、木琴、单簧管、班卓琴、尤克里里、特雷门琴、夏威夷吉他、风笛及音乐锯等，营造出翻找老式78转唱片并在阁楼中演奏的氛围。专辑曲目涵盖1925年的《Ukulele Lady》及向法国抵抗运动女歌手Juliette Gréco致敬的作品，并重新演绎多首经典老歌。演奏者多为七旬以上音乐人，以严肃态度诠释这些被遗忘的风格，呈现出兼具幽默与深情的复古拼贴美学。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / sound documentary
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑并非传统音乐作品，而是由录音师Ian Brennan在芝加哥街头进行的田野录音项目。二十五位遭受枪支暴力影响的居民参与其中，年龄从十七岁到六十七岁不等，记录了他们面对暴力创伤的真实声音。录音地点选在南城社区一栋九十四岁老人住宅的前廊，恰逢特朗普下令向该市部署国民警卫队的当天。专辑几乎没有添加任何音乐元素，仅保留了环境声与人物讲述，展现了被遗忘社区中暴力影响的广泛程度。一位失去两个儿子的长者在讲述时情感崩溃，反复道歉，社会的不平等在此暴露无遗。项目收益将捐赠给反暴力公益组织。这是一份关于枪支暴力幸存者的声音档案，以田野录音和口述形式呈现社会议题，介于声音艺术与纪实作品之间。

items.body: Much of Europe goes on vacation in August, so there’s no better time to release an album about “adventure, travel, and the journey of life.” The Leeds post-rock quintet Din of Celestial Birds hopes their album will be the soundtrack to many road trips, ocean voyages and international flights. The music is not only good for Takeoffs & Landings, but the time in-between. As festival season approaches, one of these trips may be to see the band in person. There’s not a second to waste as the band jumps right into it with three guitars, synth, bass and drums. The music is upbeat and punchy, adding a secret weapon: this is also post-rock that one can dance to, despite its metal overtones; a keen sense of rhythm calls fans out of the mosh pit and onto the main floor. One suspects that this aspect of the music is largely responsible for the band’s swiftly-growing reputation as a stellar live act. At 3:11, “Takeoffs & Landings” is also the rare post-rock track that qualifies as a radio single. While the music is largely aggressive, veering from post-rock to math rock to progressive rock, the moments of dynamic contrast stand out. One of these arrives early in “Marmoris” when the music calms down enough for one to hear the sounds of the shore. As the bank of guitars resurfaces and the drummer viciously attacks his drums, a sense of catharsis is palpable. The well-named “When Suddenly …” races out of the gate like the opener, then stops at 2:06; for a split-second, one thinks the track has ended, when suddenly it shifts gears to establish a base of solo piano upon which all the other instruments will build; a light choir lifts the track to the stratosphere. Two of the best tracks also contain the best post-rock titles. The first of these is “From This Summit We Can See The Heavens & Stars,” whose opening minutes are remarkably restrained, to the extent that one wonders if the track had been considered for the opening slot. The attack arrives at 2:32 in a melodic, metallic surge. This is followed by a mini-synth breakdown at 3:10, which leads to a drum roll and the summit of the title; then at 5:08, just as the track is ending, an even higher peak. Highlight “I Hope That Road Leads You Somewhere Beautiful, Somewhere You Belong” succeeds with subtlety rather than bombast; reflecting its title, the music seems slightly melancholic, a love letter to the listener. August is not only the month for vacations, but transitions, implying endings and goodbyes. This piece speaks directly to the heart, setting up the multi-toned farewell finale, “Second Star To The Right, and Straight On ‘Til Morning.” Soon the vacations will be over, the kids will be back at school, and the earth will tumble farther from the sun, but not yet; may we cherish these halcyon weeks of takeoffs and landings while we still have them. (Richard Allen)
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以三把吉他、合成器、贝斯与鼓的编制，呈现节奏驱动的器乐摇滚作品，强调律动感与可舞性，在后摇框架内融入数学摇滚的复杂节拍与金属化的吉他冲击。乐评特别指出曲目在动态对比上的巧思：从《Marmolis》中海岸声景的片刻宁静，到《When Suddenly...》从全编制骤然切换至独奏钢琴与合唱的转折；《From This Summit We Can See The Heavens & Stars》在层层攀升中设置多个情绪高点；《I Hope That Road Leads You Somewhere Beautiful》则以节制取代喧哗，以忧郁旋律收束。整张专辑围绕旅行与人生旅程的概念构建，从出发到告别的弧线贯穿始终，是一张结构工整且具现场感的器乐摇滚作品。

items.body: Benga runs on interlocking guitars and a rhythm that does not let up, the sound that owned Kenyan pop for forty years. Winyo has spent twenty of those years playing it his own way, guitar in hand, singing in Luo and Swahili in a voice his countrymen named after a bird. He plays The Jago in Dalston on Sunday 9 August, a room of a couple of hundred, and most of the set is an album he has not released yet. The one piece of the record anyone can hear so far is “Mapenzi Sumu”, released in April. The title is Swahili for love is poison, and Winyo wrote it after a ten-year relationship ended. He recorded it at Ketebul Music in Nairobi, the studio behind his 2012 debut Benga Blues, with Fiston Lusambo of Afriquoi on bass, guitar and arrangement, then sent it to London for Abubilla’s Elliot Wenman to add keys, piano, synths and drums. Winyo has said he normally writes behind metaphor and this time did not, and there are lines he can barely sing without stopping. Born Shiphton Onyango on the shore of Lake Victoria, he took the Luo word for bird as his name, and twenty years of singing benga have taken him onto stages with the likes of Gilberto Gil and Vieux Farka Touré, Joss Stone and into the studio with the late Oliver Mtukudzi. The London end of that record is Abubilla Music, the label behind Winyo’s return and the promoter of this show. Abubilla and Ketebul have been working together for over a decade on Singing Wells, hauling recording gear into villages across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda to get down music that was disappearing, and Winyo has sung on those sessions, sitting in with village groups and building new songs out of what they played. The Kenyan connection reaches the venue as well. Kwame Otiende has run The Jago since 2018, and he grew up between Nairobi and western Kenya, the Luo country where benga started and where Winyo was born. Dalston has been dancing to benga in that room for years. On Sunday it comes from a man who has spent twenty years keeping it alive.   Winyo plays The Jago in Dalston on Sunday 9 August Tickets are available HERE   The post Event Preview: Winyo @ The Jago (London; Sunday, 9th August 2026) appeared first on Rhythm Passport.

items.body: Review by Chaoticreason — 4 stars.7th Kind is 'supposedly' a Chicago-based art rock band? BUT, and it is a huge but! They don't sound like they have ever even been to Chicago, let alone reside there. Good. Read on...Robert Rodi (vocals). Is their frontman, and he is more than capable of delivering the bands, excellently weird and very catchy jazz take on life. I am not a great jazz fan at all (I tend to shy away from the word Jazz), so for me to find this 'odd' work interesting is something of a revelation to my own head. It is definitely Jazz, 'but not as we know it, Jim'.This is an enigmatic band to put it mildly.They sound way more like they are from South America, but who am I to judge. They have a pretty slick Jazz sound that works for even me. I don't hate jazz, I would just rather listen to something else. This is a slightly strange album, (I think) but knowing so little about jazz, puts my whole perspective out of kilter. I generally know when I am hearing good new music, but that doesn't really apply to jazz and me. Yes, the music is hopelessly catchy, so I can only base my opinions upon that premise. I can only reiterate that I am not a fan of jazz, and will never play this album again. Except that I have stuck it on my playlist, so when it's time comes I can throw it out, as just another jazz album that I don't care for.But these guys do most certainly have something good going on... and this from a non jazz fan.I reckon that this could well appeal to all those who love 'pop' jazz with a definite twist. This is good music, that is hugely underappreciated. But what do I know, a non jazz fan?If you like catchy jazz with a twist, this will be right up your street. It really is excellent.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张来自芝加哥的前卫跨界爵士专辑，融合了艺术摇滚元素，以独特的爵士视角切入。南美风格暗示着丰富的节奏律动与异域色彩，主要由主唱Robert Rodi主导，其声线擅长呈现爵士特有的怪诞与抓耳特质。评论者虽然自认非爵士乐迷，却被这张专辑的旋律性深深吸引，尤其是那些具有强烈流行感的爵士段落。整张作品在融合层面展示了爵士与艺术摇滚之间较为新颖的结合方式，打破了传统芝加哥乐队的刻板印象。评论视角独特，坦诚描述了非爵士乐迷对跨界爵士作品的复杂反应与欣赏过程，展现了音乐跨越类型界限的魅力。

items.body: Review by arcane-beautiful — Within by Protest The Hero is the band's most progressive and melodic album to date, but still keeping their mathcore, punk and post hardcore energy. Musically the band are still shredding at tempos that would make cars jealous, with some great impressive melodic and harmonic guitar playing. Vocalist Rody Walker's voice has strengthened with each release, almost as if the band has a new vocalist, with his cleans being like a mix of Claudio Sanchez & Rob Halford. Their songwriting has improved too, with even more progressive leanings, showcasing longer and more atmospheric compositions, without any loss of energy. Also it's a short, sweet and to the point album, with it only being over half an hour long. I'd give this a high 7 to low 8 out of 10. The track I'd recommend is The Mariner.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑被评价为乐队迄今为止最具前卫感和旋律性的作品，同时保留了数学核、朋克与后硬核的能量。吉他演奏速度极快，兼具旋律性与和声感。主唱Rody Walker的声线愈发成熟，清腔音色被比作Claudio Sanchez与Rob Halford的混合体。创作上更趋向前卫化，曲目更长且更具氛围感，整体半小时出头，精炼而紧凑。评论者给出了7到8分的区间评价。推荐曲目为《The Mariner》。该专辑虽然带有一定的前卫元素和跨风格融合倾向，但本质上仍属金属类摇滚范畴，与用户的实验、电子、爵士等核心偏好存在一定距离。

items.body: Review by Hrychu — Personally, I like SEI a lot and it might be my favorite Maschera di cera album. I find Maschera'sprevious output to be a mixed bag to tell you the truth. I listened to the debut, Grande labirintoand LuxAde and I always had the impression that, while the writing and compositions were reallystrong, the production was really fricking mediocre. Plus, the anemic raw and minimalisticorchestration didn't bring out the best of those compositions. Those albums felt a little too staleevery once in a while.But, luckily, SEI really did give me a sense of Maschera taking a leap in the right direction. Iimmediately noticed that the album had more varied orchestration than its predecessors. The bandutilized more instrumental textures and arrangement variation throughout the whole runtime of thisalbum, which makes it feel more lively. There are more parts that show movement in the keyboarddepartment, acoustic guitar driven sections come up more frequently, and in addition to the flute,other wind instruments joined the party. That's a huge step up imo, from the quite undercookedapproach that relied mostly on overdriven hammond organ, guitar and rhythm section with occasionalsynths. Super cool stuff!

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑延续意大利前卫摇滚传统，在编曲与制作层面较乐队前作有明显提升。评论者认为前几张作品虽创作扎实，但编排偏于单调，主要依赖过载哈蒙德风琴、吉他与节奏组，配器层次不足。新作则引入更丰富的乐器织体，键盘段落更具动态，木吉他驱动的段落出现频率增加，长笛之外加入了其他管乐器，使整体音响更生动。这种配器多样化与编排层次的提升，被视为乐队朝着更成熟方向迈进的标志，但仍属于传统前卫摇滚范畴内的渐进改良，而非根本性的风格突破或跨界实验。

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — References to Emerson, Lake & Palmer are unavoidable in "The Seven Movements of the Third Majesty", the first of three tracks making up the second album by Ring Van M�bius (themselves a trio). Yet, starting with "The 3rd Majesty," they truly make the 70s sound their own, playing with such feeling, emotion, and conviction that they earn the right to wear their influences openly. After all, there is a fine line between merely copying a sound for convenience and channeling an influence born of years of listening and a genuine love for the genre, a path to finding one's own voice that even the greatest bands have walked, and one that ultimately comes down to the individual listener's taste. The surging Minimoog lines, the frenetic, air-slicing drums, and the bass advancing like a blitzkrieg leave no doubt; shifting from rock-style Hammond organ to jazzier tones, the only thing left to do is enjoy the superb musicianship and the fresh melodies, melodies that resemble constellations in the cosmos. Just as the scientific community discovers new ones, isn't that the perfect terrain for progressive rock? Space constellations... suddenly, the tempo slows, leaving the bass, drums, and Thor Erik Helgesen's vocals floating as if in a sci-fi series.Around the midpoint of the track, the organ takes on a distorted sound, accompanied by bass and drums that turn psychedelic, and at times they abandon their polished approach for a raw sound, losing the melody and improvising; the same applies to the vocalist, who lets loose and screams, not like Hammill, but in his own style, lending the music a vibrant, original character.Things get heavy towards the end of "The Seven Movements of the Third Majesty"; the organ takes on an atonal, distorted sound, reminiscent of Van der Graaf Generator, marking the moment Ring Van M�bius truly comes into its own as a trio. It is not just about their playing, but also their composition and passionate execution, the third pillar of a great band on a great album."Illuminati" may continue to evoke Tarkus in their instrumental work, but Thor Erik Helgesen's vocal style leans closer to Deep Purple, yielding a completely different result; then they shift into jazz-rock, and a Renaissance-style section takes over, followed by instrumental passages featuring electric clavichord underpinned by drums and bass, the likes of which one might think we would no longer hear these days. Yet, the raw Norwegian intensity of the performance makes it feel new, original, and fresh. When the vocals need to be high-pitched and delicate, they deliver just that, and in the span of a mere five minutes, "Illuminati" manages to encompass the feel of multiple different songs."Distant Sphere" features a string section, and the shift in texture works beautifully; the arrangement is highly original, as is the way the trio enters immediately after, creating a space-like atmosphere with bass and Rhodes keyboard. When the drums kick in, it sounds like a trio featuring Bill Bruford, John Wetton, and Dave Stewart. The composition here is far more experimental, it is hard to believe it is just a trio, with the keyboard once again distorted to the point of frenzy; meanwhile, when they play jazz, they do so with an admirable groove, proving themselves worthy heirs to the Norwegian tradition in this regard as well. They also infuse the music with an ethereal, mysterious quality characteristic of space rock, a genre that influenced 1970s jazz-rock, and now influences them."The M�bius Ring" is a Yes-style rock track featuring Chris Squire-esque bass work; yet, when Thor Erik Helgesen sings, he makes the song his own, imbuing it with the band's signature stamp, a noble wildness reminiscent of fur coats and boots. The keyboards provide a grand, symphonic finale that gives way to the bass, where H�vard Rasmussen proves himself every bit as virtuosic as his bandmates. On drums, Dag Olav Hus�s even plays the timpani to mirror Thor Erik Helgesen's vocal inflections. It is a majestic journey, driven by a Minimoog line that stretches toward the horizon, where the sky meets a sea teeming with monsters promising unforgettable adventures, before looping back in a circular path: like a M�bius strip, like a ring, and like the trio's discography, which was just beginning here.
items._genre: symphonic prog / progressive rock / vintage keyboard-driven
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是挪威三人乐队Ring van Möbius的第二张作品，以70年代交响前卫摇滚为基调，大量使用Minimoog、Hammond风琴及Rhodes电钢琴，节奏紧凑而富有冲击力。评论指出乐队深受Emerson, Lake & Palmer、Van der Graaf Generator等经典乐队影响，但在旋律构思与情绪表达上逐渐形成自己的声音。三首曲目分别展现了不同的色彩：第一首以多乐章结构展开，从太空意象的漂浮段落过渡到迷幻即兴与失真管风琴的沉重尾声；第二首在器乐部分借鉴Tarkus，主唱风格接近Deep Purple，还融入爵士摇滚与文艺复兴式段落；第三首引入弦乐与Rhodes键盘，营造宇宙感的氛围。三人编制在乐器编排上层次丰富，既有原声质感的段落，也有即兴爆发力。整体偏向对经典前卫摇滚的致敬与再诠释，融合爵士与迷幻元素，具有一定的实验意识，但仍扎根于传统摇滚框架内。

items._cn_summary: 本乐评介绍了一张由Christoph Erb（次中音与高音萨克斯）、Jason Roebke（贝斯）和Jason Adasiewicz（颤音琴）组成的自由即兴三重奏的第三张专辑《Dream Between This》。Erb是瑞士琉森的音乐家，运营着自己的小厂牌veto-records；Roebke与Adasiewicz则是芝加哥自由即兴场景的核心成员。专辑延续了三人以萨克斯、颤音琴与贝斯为核心的纯器乐即兴对话框架，注重声学乐器之间的质感碰撞与互动结构。由于正文内容较为简短，仅提供了基本成员信息和厂牌背景，对专辑具体的音乐手法、即兴策略及录音细节描述不足，因此评价的深度有限。作为一张独立厂牌发行的自由即兴作品，其概念契合学院派自由爵士与前卫即兴的审美取向。

items.body: Belgian electro-industrial act Suicide Commando releases “Destroyer of Worlds (SGNLS Version)” via Out Of Line Music on 7 August 2026. The track is a collaboration with dark techno and EBM project DSTRTD SGNL, who rework the industrial architecture Johan Van Roy built for the original. Destroyer of Worlds (SGNLS Version) by Suicide Commando “Destroyer of Worlds” first appeared on Suicide Commando’s most recent studio album, “Goddestruktor,” released in 2022, which reached number 9 on the official German album charts. For the SGNLS Version, DSTRTD SGNL apply their dark techno and EBM production approach to the track, reshaping its structure for club and festival play while keeping Van Roy’s original vocal and industrial framework intact. DSTRTD SGNL is the German duo of Stephan Kessler and Torben Schmidt, active since 2021 in techno, EBM and dark electro, with a catalog of singles, EPs and remixes released mainly through Infacted Recordings, including collaborative work with acts such as Ruined Conflict and Mängelexemplar. The release arrives as Suicide Commando marks 40 years of activity, having formed in 1986. The project’s recent anniversary release, “Collective Suicide Vol. 1+2,” gathers material spanning early demo tapes through reworked classics alongside the new track “Control & Consent.” It is available on limited colored vinyl and as a strictly limited Wooden Fan Box Set restricted to 200 copies, containing a Digipak CD, colored double vinyl editions of both volumes and a 36-page photo book covering the band’s history. Suicide Commando live dates Suicide Commando has confirmed the following live dates: 22.08.2026 – Sao Paulo, Brazil 29.08.2026 – Mexico City, Mexico 11.12.2026 – Bielefeld, Germany 12.12.2026 – Oberhausen, Germany 15.01.2027 – Barcelona, Spain 16.01.2027 – Madrid, Spain About Suicide Commando Suicide Commando is the solo project of Belgian musician and producer Johan Van Roy, who began experimenting with electronic music in 1986. He self-released demo tapes through the late 1980s before being signed by the German label Off Beat, where his 1994 debut full-length, “Critical Stage,” marked a turning point for the project. A second album, “Stored Images,” followed in 1995 and included one of Van Roy’s most enduring songs, “See You in Hell.” Van Roy co-founded the Dependent label in 1999, releasing “Mindstrip” in 2000, which reached number one on the German alternative chart, alongside the singles “Hellraiser” and “Comatose Delusion.” The 2003 album “Axis of Evil” was voted album of the year by the Deutsche Alternative Charts, and 2006’s “Bind, Torture, Kill” reached the top of the same chart on the strength of the single “Godsend + Menschenfresser.” In 2009, Van Roy signed Suicide Commando to Out of Line Music, releasing the 7″ “Severed Head / Until We Die” followed by the EP “Die Motherfucker Die,” which also topped the German alternative chart. “Implements of Hell” followed in 2010, then “When Evil Speaks” in 2013, “Forest of the Impaled” in 2017 and “Goddestruktor” in 2022, which reached number 9 on the official German album charts. For live performances, Van Roy is joined by Torben Schmidt on keyboards and Mario Vaerewijck on drums. “Destroyer of Worlds (SGNLS Version),” released as Suicide Commando marks its 40th anniversary, continues the project’s recent run of anniversary-focused releases alongside “Collective Suicide Vol. 1+2.”
items._genre: electro-industrial / EBM / dark techno / dark electro
items._cn_summary: 比利时电工业老牌乐队Suicide Commando与德国黑暗电子二人组DSTRTD SGNL合作，重新演绎2022年专辑《Goddestruktor》中的曲目《Destroyer of Worlds》。DSTRTD SGNL以暗黑科技舞曲和EBM的制作手法重塑原曲结构，保留Johan Van Roy原始人声与工业框架，同时为俱乐部和音乐节场景优化节奏编排。Suicide Commando自1986年活动至今已满40周年，同期发行纪念合辑《Collective Suicide Vol. 1+2》，收录从早期Demo到经典重制作品及全新单曲《Control & Consent》，以限量彩胶和木制收藏盒装发行。文章本质为厂牌新闻稿，缺乏深度乐评内容，但作为暗黑电子/EBM/工业领域的合作重制，契合暗潮与电子品类的偏好。

items.body: Istanbul darkwave duo Ductape will release their new album, “Faded Flowers”, on September 18, 2026 through Swiss Dark Nights, distributed by Audioglobe. The label describes the record as Ductape’s “most cinematic work” to date, built around themes of social alienation and emotional collapse. “Faded Flowers” arrives in three physical formats: a limited edition of 500 copies on white opaque vinyl (SDNR170LP1), a limited edition of 500 copies on white transparent vinyl with mauve dots (SDNR170LP2), and a digipack CD (SDNR170CD). Both vinyl editions include a folded 60x30cm insert with band photos and full lyrics, while the CD comes with a 12-page booklet. ‘Faded Flowers’: themes and advance singles Ductape is the project of Çağla Güleray and Furkan Güleray. On “Faded Flowers”, the duo pairs synthesizers and cold basslines with guitar lines and Çağla’s vocals, building on the image of humanity as a “field of faded flowers”: individuals worn down by repetition, isolation and conformity. The label notes the album questions modern “false gods”, from social constructs to digital identities, describing emotional survival within it as a form of resistance. Three singles have preceded the album. “Fine” was the first, followed by the Turkish-language track “Gölgesiz”, and most recently “Obscure”. The tracklist for “Faded Flowers” is: Figures Fine Obscure Gölgesiz Velvet Dawn Burn D.E.R.T. Sad Gravity Delilik Last Dance Ductape European tour dates Ductape will support “Faded Flowers” with a European tour that begins in August 2026: August 21, 2026 – Stella Nomine Festival, Germany September 4, 2026 – Vienna, Austria (Das Lot) September 5, 2026 – Graz, Austria (PPC) September 11, 2026 – Marseille, France (Le Molotov) September 12, 2026 – Paris, France (Le Petit Bain) September 25, 2026 – Karlsruhe, Germany (Die Stadtmitte) September 26, 2026 – Rüsselsheim, Germany (Das Rind) October 23, 2026 – Moers, Germany (Bollwerk 107) October 24, 2026 – Reutlingen, Germany (Takt Bizarre Festival) November 14, 2026 – Madrid, Spain (Santuario Festival) November 20, 2026 – Copenhagen, Denmark (Rust) November 21, 2026 – Gothenburg, Sweden (Abyss) November 26, 2026 – Hannover, Germany (Subkultur) November 27, 2026 – Münster, Germany (Gleis 22) November 28, 2026 – Bochum, Germany (Gleis 9) November 29, 2026 – Porto, Portugal (Auditorio CCOP) December 4, 2026 – Toulouse, France (Le Chorus) December 5, 2026 – Belgrade, Serbia (Klub Under) December 11, 2026 – Sofia, Bulgaria December 12, 2026 – Skopje, North Macedonia December 18, 2026 – Ljubljana, Slovenia (Gromka) About Ductape Ductape is a darkwave duo formed by Çağla Güleray and Furkan Güleray, emerging from Istanbul’s underground music scene. The project’s earlier releases include the albums “Araf”, “Echo Drama” and “Labirent”, along with “Ruh” and a live recording, “Live at Radyo Modyan”. Ductape has toured extensively across Europe and South America, building a following within the post-punk and darkwave scenes. “Faded Flowers”, out September 18, 2026 via Swiss Dark Nights, is described by the band’s label as the group’s most conceptually focused work to date.
items._cn_summary: 伊斯坦布尔暗潮二人组Ductape即将通过瑞士小厂牌Swiss Dark Nights发行新专辑《Faded Flowers》，由Audioglobe分销。专辑以合成器、冷峻贝斯与吉他线条交织，辅以女主唱Çağla的声线，构建出被誉为该组合迄今最具'电影感'的声响氛围。主题围绕社会疏离与情感崩塌展开，将现代人比作'枯萎花田'中的个体，质问社交建构与数字身份等'虚假的'。制作上推出白胶限量版、白透紫斑限量版及Digipak CD三种实体格式。土耳其语单曲《Gölgesiz》的纳入暗示本土文化元素，但整体仍属欧洲暗潮语境内的常规制作。文中提供完整曲目及欧洲巡演日程。

items.album: Emile Omar Présente Déclic, Kaz A Zouk : Zouk - Créole Rap & Ragga - Kompa - Gwo Ka Modern (1987 - 1998)
items.excerpt: Classy haul of dancehall and street soul-adjacent Zouk from the Caribbean isles, cooked up by Disques Debs, Radio Nova, and Tropical Discoteq programer Émile Omar. Check for the orchestral dates and raggo Créole flow of ‘Mwen inmin’ by Metal Sound; the syrupy sway of Claudy Siar and O’Taïm gems; the low-slung rap of... more
items.body:
Classy haul of dancehall and street soul-adjacent Zouk from the Caribbean isles, cooked up by Disques Debs, Radio Nova, and Tropical Discoteq programer Émile Omar. Check for the orchestral dates and raggo Créole flow of ‘Mwen inmin’ by Metal Sound; the syrupy sway of Claudy Siar and O’Taïm gems; the low-slung rap of X’Taz.

“Back to the golden nights of zouk clubs, where hip-hop, kompa, zouk and Caribbean grooves ruled the dance-floor. This selection documents a pivotal moment : a time when zouk was still not a fixed genre, but more a place, an atmosphere, somewhere people went to dance. It captures the spirit of an era: its creative effervescence, musical freedom, and the diversity of artists who shaped it. The very concept of “Kaz A Zouk” perfectly encapsulates this idea: a space where all styles could meet.”
items._genre: zouk / créole rap / ragga / kompa / gwo ka
items._cn_summary: 这是一张聚焦于1987至1998年间加勒比海群岛Zouk音乐黄金年代的合辑，由Disques Debs、Radio Nova及策展人Émile Omar共同梳理。专辑收录了Metal Sound的管弦乐编制与克里奥尔语ragga律动作品《Mwen inmin》、Claudy Siar与O'Taïm的慵懒摇摆曲目，以及X'Taz的低沉说唱节拍。整张合辑的核心理念在于捕捉Zouk尚未固化为单一流派的历史时刻——它更像是一种氛围、一个人们前往跳舞的场所，而非明确的音乐类型标签。选曲呈现了那个时代Hip-hop、Kompa、Zouk与加勒比律动在舞池交汇的创作活力与音乐自由，展现了塑造这一场景的多样化艺术家群像。

items.album: The Bristol & Bath Blitz Club Meets Art School Sound - 80's Explosion
items.excerpt: Avon’s lesser-hailed, glam ‘80s synth-pop and new wave movement is spotlighted in-depth via 20 songs compiled by studio engineer Dave Massey, who smartly portrays the breadth and quality of an ‘80s blindspot. ‘The Bristol & Bath Blitz Club Meets Art School Sound - 80's Explosion’ traces the reverberating influence of Rusty Egan... more
items.body:
Avon’s lesser-hailed, glam ‘80s synth-pop and new wave movement is spotlighted in-depth via 20 songs compiled by studio engineer Dave Massey, who smartly portrays the breadth and quality of an ‘80s blindspot.

‘The Bristol & Bath Blitz Club Meets Art School Sound - 80's Explosion’ traces the reverberating influence of Rusty Egan and co.’s new wave crucible, The Blitz Club, along the M4 leyline, where it met Avon art school kids advancing from punk and funk into a new decade. Egan’s signature DJ brew - e.g. Kraftwerk to Visage, Burundi Black to Bowie, Japan and Grace Jones - would spark myriad emulators who were also mirroring the chops of Duran Duran (sons of the Brum club scene an hour north) and the likes of Martyn Ware et al in Sheffield, in their blends of US funk, European machine music, and a punky license to follow their nose. 

Fair to say it’s not the usual tale of Bristol’s dub-rooted and punk heritage. Between Distant Cousins’ Arabic-inflected new wave ace ‘Red Oasis’, and the angular chops of ‘Your Heart My Ambition’ from Frame By Frame, it checks for a spectrum of pop moxie taking in the swooning goth pop of Great Naked; BEF-meets-Bowie pomp of Wadi Vision; Nite Watch and glaxobabies’ disco-boogie; a stranger standout of synth sleaze by Startled Insects; Duran Duran-esque new wave funk by Creature Beat; and a ballad pearl by The Escape - all sure to mess with preconceptions of Bristol history.
items._cn_summary: 这张合辑聚焦八十年代英国布里斯托尔与巴斯地区被忽视的华丽合成器流行与新浪潮场景，由录音师戴夫·梅西汇编二十首作品，追溯伦敦Blitz俱乐部新潮风潮沿M4公路向西传播后，与当地艺术学院学子结合朋克、放克底蕴所碰撞出的独特声音。曲目涵盖阿拉伯风新浪潮、棱角分明的后朋克、哥特流行、迪斯科放克与合成器新浪潮等多种面貌，展现出该地区跨越多元风格、远不止于雷鬼根源的丰富面貌，对布里斯托尔音乐史的常规认知构成有力补充。

items.excerpt: New LP from Californian singer/songwriter Luke Temple aka Art Feynman. "Slow, unfussy, and largely instrumental, Orphans finds Art Feynman turning inward. Conceived as “music to do other things by,” the album is designed to live alongside daily activity, coloring the atmosphere without demanding focused attention... more
items.body:
New LP from Californian singer/songwriter Luke Temple aka Art Feynman.

"Slow, unfussy, and largely instrumental, Orphans finds Art Feynman turning inward. Conceived as “music to do other things by,” the album is designed to live alongside daily activity, coloring the atmosphere without demanding focused attention. It moves through a space like wind chimes, less something to follow than something to feel. These are intimate, solitary explora- tions, sketches that feel less composed than discovered, yet they carry a quiet emotional clarity. Where Feynman’s past work often leaned on intricate grooves and dense interplay, Orphans is disarmingly still, patient, and comforting.

As the album begins, you can almost picture Feynman hunched over a 4-track, tracing melodies on a small Casio, following instinct wherever it leads. Opening track “Soft Reminder,” unfolds with a gentle organ line that's equal parts melancholy and curiosity, its tones lingering in the air rather than pushing forward, settling into the room as easily as it invites quiet reflection.

Elsewhere, “Soup Song” channels a kind of homespun minimalism, its insistent organ pattern recalling the early, exploratory spirit of Terry Riley’s A Rainbow in Curved Air. “Always In Need of Something” nods toward the playful, searching qualities of Francis Bebey, its cyclical phrasing suggesting a quiet, human restlessness beneath the surface. Throughout, tones and textures gently accumulate, shaping an atmosphere as much as a set of discrete compositions, subtly shifting the emotional temperature of whatever space they inhabit.

Late-album centerpiece “Ice Bath,” one of the few vocal moments, offers a subtle thesis: “It slowed me down / That’s what I needed / For a new beginning.” The song feels like a turning point, an acceptance of stillness as a necessary condition for change. It dissolves seamlessly into “The Condition of New Things,” a gorgeously skeletal electric guitar piece that lingers in open space, each note placed with careful intention, recalling some of Jeff Parker’s solo work.

Closing track, “Plastic Flowers,” drifts in on vocoder-softened vocals and a fragile bed of guitar and synth. “To trick the eye but still touch the heart,” Feynman sings, a line that quietly frames the album’s ethos. Like light shifting across a wall over the course of a day, these recordings may be modest, even illusion-like in their simplicity, but their emotional resonance is undeniable."
items._cn_summary: Art Feynman（本名Luke Temple）的新专辑《Orphans》以慢速、低密度、近乎环境音乐的方式呈现，大量器乐段落取代了以往作品中的复杂律动与密集互动。整张专辑以四轨录音机和小型Casio键盘为核心乐器，强调即兴式探索而非精心编排，旋律在空间中自由漂浮。作品中可见Terry Riley极简重复美学与Francis Bebey质朴节奏的影响，后者带来一种世界音乐式的亲切感。歌词段落极为稀少，仅在"Ice Bath"和"Plastic Flowers"两首中以人声呈现，主题围绕静止与重新开始。电吉他段落稀疏而开放，带有Jeff Parker独奏作品的即兴色彩。整体氛围安静、舒适、沉思，适合作为日常活动的背景声响，其情感温度在不经意间渗透，而非刻意表达。

items.artist: John Carpenter, Cody Carpenter, & Daniel Davies
items.excerpt: Cathedral is a thrilling album and terrifying graphic novel from director and musician John Carpenter, based on a dream Carpenter had in 2024. "An abandoned cathedral. A gruesome murder. A powerful supernatural entity living in the catacombs. It all comes to a head in downtown Los Angeles. What will happen and who will... more
items.body:
Cathedral is a thrilling album and terrifying graphic novel from director and musician John Carpenter, based on a dream Carpenter had in 2024.

"An abandoned cathedral. A gruesome murder. A powerful supernatural entity living in the catacombs. It all comes to a head in downtown Los Angeles. What will happen and who will live to tell the tale? Such is the storyline of Cathedral, it has all the drama, dark atmosphere, and frenetic pacing of a classic heavy metal record. Especially designed as the soundtrack to the graphic novel, each track corresponds to a specific section of the book. The liner notes included with the album packaging feature prompts for each track, creating a fully interactive experience. Combined with the graphic novel, it’s the closest thing to a new John Carpenter film in years.

The music on Cathedral retains all the eerie atmosphere and sinister propulsion of the epochal scores Carpenter created for his films Halloween, The Fog, and Assault on Precinct 13, but this is a much heavier, riff-driven enterprise. Carpenter is a firm believer that music plays a major role in what really makes something scary. That’s first and foremost,” the director says. “It’s all about making the music work.” “This is somewhat different sounding stuff that we’ve done, but it’s done with the same desire in mind,” he adds. “In other words, put this thing on and imagine you’re watching a movie. That’s what we want you to do.”

Daniel Davies’ soaring, snaky guitars take center stage on opener “Primeval,” “Elevator,” and the metal masterpiece “Lord of the Underground” while John Carpenter and Cody Carpenter’s synths take the lead on the ominous “Desolation in the Underworld,” the plaintive “Death of the Mapmaker,” and even converge with strings on “Abandoned Cathedral.”

Whereas the Lost Themes albums were written as scores to movies of the mind, Cathedral scores the first original graphic novel written by Carpenter, his wife and long-time creative partner, producer and editor Sandy King, and writer Sean Sobczak, published by Storm King Comics."

items._cn_summary: 约翰·卡朋特与子柯迪及吉他手丹尼尔·戴维斯合作的《Cathedral》是一部与图像小说同步发行的概念专辑。音乐延续了卡朋特在《万圣节》《迷雾》等经典恐怖片配乐中标志性的阴郁合成器氛围，但本次明显加重了吉他的比重，riff驱动的金属质感贯穿多首曲目。戴维斯的吉他线条蜿蜒突出，与卡朋特父子的合成器交替主导，形成合成器压迫感与吉他金属质感之间的张力。专辑每一首曲目对应图像小说的特定章节，包装内附文字提示以增强沉浸感，被视为近年来最接近卡朋特电影配美学的作品。整体定位介于黑暗合成器原声与重金属之间，以概念互文为核心制作逻辑。

items.excerpt: Class vinyl debut of Lee ‘Scratch’ Perry’s live band bass player, Slim Levy, trading in charmingly dare-to-differ cosmic dub sorcery on an ideal home for this type of lark - Disrupt’s indomitable Jahtari. Aside to private dubplates, ’Snippet Sounds’ is the French multi-instrumentalist’s first record, proper; a carousel of gently... more
items.body:
Class vinyl debut of Lee ‘Scratch’ Perry’s live band bass player, Slim Levy, trading in charmingly dare-to-differ cosmic dub sorcery on an ideal home for this type of lark - Disrupt’s indomitable Jahtari.

Aside to private dubplates, ’Snippet Sounds’ is the French multi-instrumentalist’s first record, proper; a carousel of gently psychoactive and subtle skews on convention that chimes with soundsystema nd dub outliers such as Sheriff Lindo or Tapes, or the rest of the of the Jahtari kru, for that matter. 

Taking equal cues from his former bandleader (he played on Perry’s last tour), and The Beach Boys’ ‘Pet Sounds’, the set reels to 14 succinct and DJ-ready parts, dancing between toytronic vignettes and more fully formed knees-ups that echo the strange, innovative spectres of ‘70s Black Ark output via more lo-fi tekkerz.

To play favourites, we advise checking for the plucky, air-step skank of ‘Chalaladub’, the rickety ‘Chim Cherie’ vintage vibe of ‘Characteristics’ and ‘Train Train’, or perfectly sozzled drunken master style of ‘The Evil Cowboy Condor’, thru the early digickal bubbler ‘Wake Up John’. But ultimately we reckon it’s best taken in one go, where the tidgier bits come into their own in an album context.

items._cn_summary: 法国多乐器演奏者Slim Levy的首张正式专辑，在Disrupt旗下厂牌Jahtari发行。他曾是Lee 'Scratch' Perry现场乐队中的贝斯手，专辑将Pet Sounds式的和声美学与70年代Black Ark时期dub制作的实验精神相融合，辅以低保真电子手法与8-bit音色质感。14首短小精悍的曲目围绕dub回响、玩具般的电子音色与cosmic风格展开，从轻快跳跃的Chalaladub到模拟老式合成器质感的Train Train，再到醉酒般扭曲的The Evil Cowboy Condor，呈现出碎片化却不失连贯性的声音拼贴。作为唱片骑师友好的专辑整体聆听效果最佳，单曲之间的流动性与互补性使其在dj set中也能独立成立。整体属于独立实验电子场景中具有个人特色的dub变奏作品。

items._cn_summary: 这张合辑收录了Lee "Scratch" Perry在Black Ark工作室（1977-1979年）制作的五首经典discomix混音作品，通过Studio 16厂牌再版发行。Disco Devil系列专注于挖掘Perry在这一时期标志性的dub混音手法，将原始录音拆解、重组，加入大量的回响、延迟与空间效果处理。这些作品体现了Perry作为dub音乐先驱对声音空间感的极致探索，混音本身即成为独立的创作行为。作为70年代后期dub黄金时代的档案性再版，其价值更多在于历史意义与制作工艺的展现，而非新的艺术突破。内容仅为简短的信息发布，缺乏深入的乐评分析，信息量极为有限。整体而言属于具有实验精神的dub混音作品，与用户的电子与实验口味有一定距离，主要吸引力在于其历史地位与独特的混音美学。

items.body: Overflowing delivers an oceanic body of shifting harmonies, melodious vibes, and cool, soft-rock resonances. Sparse textural ambient motifs punctuate the ensemble, as in the granular and free-flowing “Sunbird.” Emotionally, the music is entirely connected with hope and gentle bitterness. An oceanic body of shifting harmonies Brad Deschamps is a busy sound artist and talented producer involved in numerous projects (anthéne, North Atlantic Drift, Rosales), highly appreciated by avid listeners of craft-based ambient music and beyond. I had the pleasure of listening to and reviewing a handful of albums he has made, and more generally releases from his labels Polar Seas and Floralia. Polar Seas now stands among the major indie labels with an interest in organic and chamber-like ambient music, alongside Home Normal, Past Inside The Present, Hibernate, Sound in Silence, and Dead Pilots. In this regard, the cassette rewild (published on Floralia) was a marvelous, emotional, and profound musical voyage to the confines of micro-noise and instrumental post-rock ambient, augmented by lamenting vocals, an experience close to Loren Connors‘ Hell’s Kitchen Park. Irresistible sentimental spleen and “happy-sad” hymns. This project, called Early Moon, is actually not far from what you can hear on rewild, built around shoegazing and vibrant aerial guitar moods but with more emphasis on rock elements through the presence of Andrew Eyles (bass, percussion). The result is far from being fully dedicated ambient music, yet there are hints of North Atlantic Drift in the meandering, textured, and engaging instrumental guitar sections that paint inner landscapes. Overflowing delivers an oceanic body of shifting harmonies, melodious vibes, and cool, soft-rock resonances. Sparse textural ambient motifs punctuate the ensemble, as in the granular and free-flowing “Sunbird.” Emotionally, the music is entirely connected with hope and gentle bitterness. Once more, whether working solo or in collaboration, Brad Deschamps does not disappoint. A delicate semi-ambient rock album of alluring reflectiveness, it is easily recommended for fans of Mono, This Will Destroy You, Pan American, Michael Rother (some passages of Sterntaler), and Seeland by Neu! (1975). Overflowing is available on Polar Seas. [Bandcamp] Overflowing by Early MoonThe post Early Moon :: Overflowing (Polar Seas) first appeared on Igloo Magazine.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以飘渺的吉他音色为骨架，融入了柔和摇滚的旋律感与氛围音乐的环境质感。Brad Deschamps延续了其在North Atlantic Drift等项目中的质感营造手法，作品在和声层叠与情绪铺陈间游走，呈现出希望与苦涩交织的情感色调。稀疏的颗粒化音色点缀其间，如曲目《Sunbird》中的自由流动段落。Andrew Eyles的贝斯与打击乐为整体增添了摇滚的肌理，但并未使作品完全脱离氛围音乐的范畴。乐评将其与Loren Connors的细腻情感、Mono和This Will Destroy You的后摇滚气质相比较，适合偏好轻柔器乐与情绪氛围交织的听众。

items.body: The Polish festival will head Stateside for three days at Lincoln Center this October Actress Unsound has shared the first wave of acts playing its NYC edition later this year. Taking place across three days at the city's Lincoln Center, it will follow the festival's flagship Polish edition in Warsaw and Kraków earlier in October, and comes ahead of a London edition scheduled for November – full information on the latter is currently yet to be announced. The New York programme will see Actress present his new live show accompanying upcoming album Radical Frame, while claire rousay and Martyna Basta are due to link up for a new show called hotel room. items.body: Review by yarstruly — Clicked 4, but really a bit better at 4.25.Let's call this one, back to "Bass-ics" as this album features three of the world's top bassists in a collaboration called "Dystopia". Alberto Rigoni (Jeff Scott Soto, Jordan Rudess, Marco Minnemann, Gavin Harrison), Michael Manring (Spastic Ink, Alex Skolnik/Skol Patrol, Attention Deficit, Steve Morse, Alex De Grassi, Will Ackerman and others) and Stuart (Stu) Hamm (Steve Vai, Joe Satriani, Frank Gambale) are the bassists and they are augmented by drummers Tim "Herb" Alexander (Primus) and David Menoudakis (Motion Device). Rigoni is the album's producer.The album comes courtesy of the all-around awesome guy Nick Katona (the man has style!) and his label Melodic Revolution Records (MMR). It was released on February 27, 2026. I look forward to reviewing more music released by this label. As always, this is a cold listen, I receive no additional compensation, and I call it like I hear it. The only frame of reference I have going into this is "Fish Out of Water" by the late, great Chris Squire, but this album is a fully instrumental affair, so it should be interesting. Without further ado, let's get down deep into it.Track 1 - Genesis (4:26)A moderately slow chordal pattern starts off the track, and a cool drum groove comes in with a polyrhythmic pattern. At around 1 minute in, they lock into a groove. They are using some effects that make some of the bass notes sound almost brass-like; very cool. The drums play some amazing fills. The groove changes at around 3:25. I don't know which bassist is playing what, but there was a cool lead break near the ending. Great tune!Track 2 - The Algorithm (3:16)This begins with droning sounds, onto which a fretless bass plays an opening tune. So far there are no drums on this and it is very atmospheric. I wonder if one or more of them is using a synth pickup module to create some of these sounds. Nice soundscape track.Track 3 - Entropia (3:55)This one has a jazzy groove to it, with shifting meters. It's very proggy! Lots of great rhythms here. There is a melodic hook. Cool bass and drum synchronicity at around 3:20 on a morse code rhythm. I like it!Track 4 - Limbo (3:59)This fades in with some foreboding sounds. No drums on this one. There is a sense of motion, however, caused by the rhythms. One of the basses takes on a piano-like tone. There are some unique effects in the later part of the track. Pretty interesting.Track 5 - Solar (3:27)I like the descending, chord-melody thing that they start with here. The drums are back in a big way here. I like the changing melodies and grooves throughout this track. These guys are definitely among the best in the world and are showing it on this track. Great drum solo after 3 minutes. One of my favorites from the album, I'd say!Track 6 - Ethereal Horizon (2:34)Bass harmonics are featured as this one begins. The synth-like tones are back; maybe a whammy pedal? They are certainly re-defining what the bass can do here. Track 7 - Dystopia (8:46)The final/title track is the longest, so let's call it a closing epic. A rhythm pattern with drums is established quickly. At around 1:30 one of the guys takes on a lead guitar type tone, which is later harmonized with another player; they use a distortion effect. Following that, there is a really cool canon-like section with the three playing overlapping tunes. Great drum grooves on this as well. They really take us through several grooves and moods. I love the groove that kicks in at around the 5-minute mark. I like the slow harmonies as they approach the 7-minute mark; gradually all 3 of them take part in the chords, and there are overdubs as well as it keeps building. It is a rich, brassy tone they are creating. The bass can create many timbres and they show it here. The only thing missing for me is a final punctuation for the ending, as it just kind of stopped. Otherwise, this is clearly the flag-ship track of the album.OVERALL IMPRESSIONS:This is a fairly short album at around 31 minutes, perhaps we should call it an EP. Regardless, this is an entertaining way to spend half an hour and see what three master-bassists (sorry, I'll go sit in the corner now?) can do. It was an interesting experiment and yielded some cool results. I have no Idea whether they are planning to follow-up with more releases, but it's worth checking out. I'll give this a respectable 4.25 out of 5, or 85%. Thanks again to Nick Katona and MRR for providing me with this music for review. I expect there be more in the not-too-distant future.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张以贝斯为主导的前卫器乐专辑，由Alberto Rigoni联合Michael Manring与Stuart Hamm三位顶级贝斯手共同演绎，鼓手Tim Alexander与David Menoudakis提供节奏支撑。整张专辑偏向纯器乐探索，融合了爵士节奏、氛围音效与前卫摇滚元素。从乐评描述来看，曲目如Genesis以多律动复合节奏构建段落感，The Algorithm与Limbo侧重氛围铺陈与合成器化贝斯音色，Solar展现了变化丰富的旋律与鼓的爆发力，Ethereal Horizon则以贝斯泛音开场并探索whammy pedal等非常规效果。整体定位偏向技术派贝斯炫技与前卫融合，对实验前卫与爵士融合有一定兴趣的听众可能获得满足，但整体仍以器乐炫技为主线，缺乏更深层的实验突破或跨文化融合视角。

items.body: For Swedish post-punk and goth rock stalwarts Then Comes Silence, songwriting works best when it carries a little danger in its coat pocket, along with a nightclub flyer, a bent cigarette, and perhaps the phone number of somebody your mother warned you about. On Judgement Day, the Stockholm trio take that instinct and feed it through a bright synth opening that sounds almost indecently cheerful before the floor gives way beneath it. The melody initially suggests a lost continental dance hit, polished enough to wander into an airport lounge without being questioned. Then Alex Svenson’s voice enters, carrying the moral weight of a man reading names from a very unpleasant guest list, while Jonas Fransson’s drums and Hugo Zombie’s guitar tighten the track into a stern, muscular march. Clan of Xymox, Killing Joke, and The Chameleons provide useful reference points, though Then Comes Silence retain their own heavy-footed grandeur, where every bass note seems dressed for a funeral, and every hook reads like a majestic elegy for the human race. “This song is about failure, bad decisions and poor behaviour – those who will be the first in line on doomsday,” the band explains. The humor—or perhaps the confession—resides in the arrangement. By featuring an almost alien electronic motif at the outset, the trio playfully embeds their own musical misbehavior, all while enjoying the process. Then Comes Silence greet the end with a crooked smile, loosening goth’s funeral tie and sparing Judgement Day the pallbearer solemnity so often mistaken for depth. Director Damon Zurawski of Future Legends Films places the band among dancers drawn from the gothic scene, creating a performance video that feels communal without sanding down the song’s severity. Svenson commands the center with bass in hand, Fransson drives from behind the kit, and Zombie cuts through the room with economical force. The dancers supply movement, personality, and proof that black clothing contains more shades than most paint stores. Watch the video for Judgement Day below: Judgement Day introduces Requiem Ballroom, due out on November 20th on Metropolis Records. The album follows 2024’s Trickery, a record Classic Rock described as “the post-punk influence of Bauhaus or Joy Division offset by an ’80s windblown, cinematic sense of drama presented with silky production and confidence.” Vive Le Rock concurred, remarking on its “huge, spectral sound that cascades the post-punk genres seamlessly whilst delivering a unique and compelling sound that is as captivatingly gripping as it is intense.” After years of stages shared with Fields of the Nephilim, Clan of Xymox, Chameleons, and A Place to Bury Strangers, Then Comes Silence sound firmly in possession of their machinery. Judgement Day turns failure into propulsion, poor behavior into choreography, and doomsday into a club night worth attending before the lights come up and the bill inevitably comes due at dawn. Then Comes Silence are on tour in mainland Europe in August and September, including an appearance at the M’era Luna Festival in Hildesheim, Germany on 9th August. Further info and tickets for all shows can be found HERE. items._cn_summary: 瑞典后朋克与哥特摇滚乐队Then Comes Silence发布新单曲《Judgement Day》，作为专辑《Requiem Ballroom》的先行曲。歌曲以一段近乎轻快的合成器旋律开场，随后主唱低沉凝重的声线与军鼓、吉他构成的沉重行军节奏将氛围拉入哥特式的庄严中。歌词探讨失败、不当行为与末日审判，乐队自述将末日主题包装成值得参与的俱乐部之夜，试图在哥特的葬礼氛围中保留一丝玩味的笑意。MV由Damon Zurawski执导，召集哥特社群舞者共同出镜，表演视频兼具群体感与音乐的压迫感。评论援引Clan of Xymox、Killing Joke、The Chameleons作为参照，指出乐队延续了经典后朋克的沉重优雅，但声音设计更趋明亮、合成器层次更为突出。整体属于传统的哥特摇滚框架内，加入了轻电子化的开场动机，但在实验性与融合性上未见明显突破。
